notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38462416/eca3dffc9d1582c32cc18c6ee91c721ab6b398be.png"][/img][/p][p][u][b]Version 4.8.0 (2025-08)[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]\[ADDED] Heroes Volume 2 dice pack support.[/p][/*][*][p]\[ADDED] Apple Silicon native support.[/p][/*][*][p]\[UPDATED] Dice can be thrown anywhere on tabletop, not just in chat box. Hold Alt when dragging desktop dice to roll without broadcasting.[/p][/*][*][p]\[UPDATED] Dice can be previewed via dice window by hovering over dice set, regardless of ownership.[/p][/*][*][p]\[UPDATED] Dice window reworked to add support for separate tray/roll scale, as well as preview on hover.[/p][/*][*][p]\[UPDATED] Story Book navigation reworked.[/p][/*][*][p]\[UPDATED] Built-in dialog color scheme revised.[/p][/*][*][p]\[UPDATED] PC portrait and NPC picture fields will fit the image to the full field space.[/p][/*][*][p]\[FIXED] In images, token targeting arrows not drawing correctly when using hex grids.[/p][/*][*][p]\[DEV]\[ADDED] tokencontrol - Add drawmode tag support.[/p][/*][*][p]\[DEV]\[ADDED] numbercontrol - Add percentsign tag to automatically append percent character.[/p][/*][*][p]\[DEV]\[ADDED] windowcontrol - Support for disabled state frames (enabled state or read only state will show new state frame).[/p][/*][*][p]\[DEV]\[FIXED] tokeninstance - Menus and callbacks tied to token instance objects would be lost when closing any image control containing token instance.[/p][/*][/list][p][u][b]Ruleset Updates 2025-08[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]\[CoreRPG+]\[UPDATED] Dice window reworked to add support for separate tray/roll scale, as well as preview on hover.[/p][/*][*][p]\[CoreRPG+]\[UPDATED] Story Book navigation reworked.[/p][/*][*][p]\[CoreRPG+]\[UPDATED] PC portrait and NPC picture fields will fit the image to the full field space.[/p][/*][*][p]\[CoreRPG+]\[DEV]\[UPDATED] buttongroup_counter template reworked to support more use cases.[/p][/*][*][p]\[CoreRPG+]\[DEV]\[UPDATED] combobox/comboboxc templates reworked to support separate value and display text.[/p][/*][*][p]\[CoreRPG+]\[DEV]\[UPDATED] combobox/comboboxc/buttongroup_radio/button_iconcycler/button_stringcycler templates reworked to support more use cases and can be interchangeable with minor changes.[/p][/*][*][p]\[MULTIPLE]\[UPDATED] Power counter preparation mode reworked.[/p][/*][*][p]\[MULTIPLE]\[FIXED] Weapon carried indicator field not displaying correctly based on Mode and Lock states.[/p][/*][*][p]\[MULTIPLE]\[FIXED] Initial PC creation would show skills that should be locked with delete icons.[/p][/*][*][p]\[5E] SRD 5.2.1 Player Data, Bestiary, and Magic Items modules added to all licenses[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Known Issues[/b][/p][p]As usual, this was in our TEST channel for a little over 3 weeks. We spend the first week after release working on hot-fixes for anything that didn't get caught or reported during testing. [/p][p]Items we are currently working on:[/p][list][*][p]Lag when reading or editing large chapters/sub-chapters in the reference manual[/p][/*][*][p]Spell preparation issues in PF1E/PF2E \[Fixed][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Announcing New Simplified Licensing
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38462416/378296b54adb622390887f1945331fd93d104c84.jpg[/img]
We are simplifying our licensing structure to make it easier for new and existing players to dive into Fantasy Grounds. Previously, customers had to choose between a Core/Standard license, an Ultimate license, and a free/Demo license. We understand that this extra decision created a barrier to adoption, so we’re making things simpler.

What’s Changing?

[list]
[*] We are eliminating the Core/Standard license.
[*] Moving forward, we will only offer the Fantasy Grounds VTT license (previously the Ultimate license) at a one-time cost of $50.
[*] The free/Demo license remains available for those who want to try out the software before purchasing.
[*] The new Fantasy Grounds VTT license will display as "Ultimate" within the application, next to the version number on the splash screen.
[/list]

What About Existing Core/Standard License Holders?

[list]
[*] If you currently own a Core/Standard license, you can continue to use it as normal.
[*] Your Fantasy Grounds VTT license will continue to display as "Core" within the application, next to the version number on the splash screen.
[*] You will have an upgrade path available to the new Fantasy Grounds VTT license for $30 at retail pricing.
[/list]

This change ensures that all paid users receive the best experience Fantasy Grounds has to offer, with full hosting capabilities and seamless game sessions. Thank you for your continued support, and we can’t wait to see you in-game!

Adventure Simplified.

notes.title: FGU v4.5.0 and 2024-03 Ruleset Updates now in TEST channel
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=qoWtA-9_psA;full][/previewyoutube]

How to join the public beta:
[olist]
[*]Launch Fantasy Grounds and choose Settings
[*]Switch to the Advanced Tab
[*]Change the Build Channel to TEST
[*]Save the Settings
[*]Run an Update
[/olist]

To return, repeat the process and choose the LIVE channel. All campaigns will be stored in their separate channels. Within the FG Data folder, you will see a new channels folder with a Test subfolder. If you need to reclaim storage space after participating in the Beta, you can delete the Test folder. Any changes you made in campaigns will not carry over to your LIVE campaigns. 

There is a current feedback thread available on the main FG forums if you want to leave feedback. Otherwise, you can share it here in the comments or in the Community Hub on Steam.

https://www.fantasygrounds.com/forums/showthread.php?80360-Feedback-Thread-FGU-v4-5-0-and-2024-03-Ruleset-Updates

notes.title: Coming in Early 2024 - First-Person View
notes.notes:
[h1]Happy New Year![/h1]

The year 2023 for us was a down year for us, but a year of big investments. Our team has been working on several cool features and we are close to releasing one of these major features - First Person View.

[h2]How does First-Person View work in a world of 2D flat RPGs? [/h2]

The best thing I can do is show you two small sneak peek videos I put together. The first is from the D&D Dragonlance module. It shows an encampment and the occupants that the players would face within. The 2D map of the area is provided within the module and placed at the feet of the players, complete with rendered line of sight, lighting effects,  and even special Fx layers. The NPCs all use the provided art from the book and these are rendered as transparent stand-ups that face towards the camera. They are scaled relative to other creatures and positioned in a way that makes sense. The result is a sort of psuedo-3d environment that allows players to look around (up, down, behind, etc.), target foes and move within this space. 

[previewyoutube=Jg8YyH0LbLw;full][/previewyoutube]

This second video is from the Fallout 2d20 ruleset. This ruleset has been lighter on maps in general, but it has great NPC artwork we can tap into. We plan to support all rulesets with this new mode. 

[previewyoutube=-l_GWmMTcWA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Is this going to be time-consuming to set up?[/h2]

We don't think so. We plan to work with internal community developers and module developers to prepare the art from the books to have transparent backgrounds and all the necessary metadata that is needed to properly scale and position everything in first-person view. When that is done, you simply click on the view mode to toggle between 2D and 3D modes.

[h2]What if I don't use a map at all? Will this support theater of the mind style play?[/h2]

Yes! This was my original impetus for developing the mode. In planning for that, it turned out that it also supports modules that already have good maps. In some ways this made it more complicated, and in other ways it made it easier. We plan to support it with additional features that let you quickly generate a scene with some NPCs and players in it when you don't have a map at all. Essentially, these automation functions will build a quick and basic map by painting some graphics on the map floor and auto-positioning NPCs and players to save GM time.

[h2]Can I still use 2D mode if I don't like this feature?[/h2]

Sure. There is a toggle to switch modes. For now, we are undecided if we want the GM to control that toggle exclusively or if we want it to be a per-user toggle. Testing and feedback from our community will help us make that determination.

[h2]What are some other future plans for this feature?[/h2]

We want to support props, terrain, and other objects rendered into the 3D space that are not NPCs. We still need to finalize the UI and data retention for these objects, but it is on our roadmap.

We also want to start looking (probably much later in 2024) into other 3D assets. Perhaps we can allow for full 3D content, walls that extend up from the floor, 3d special Fx, and maybe more.

notes.notes:
[b]🚀 Major Update: Fantasy Grounds Unity v4.4.3 Ruleset UI Upgrade[/b]

Prepare for an enhanced tabletop RPG experience with the latest update for Fantasy Grounds Unity. We're thrilled to introduce a host of new features that will take your gaming sessions to the next level:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38462416/49bdb90774c239406e33c4284a341c5d3a12f502.png[/img]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Fresh New Look:[/b] Experience a sleek, modern UI makeover for CoreRPG, D&D 5E, D&D 3.5E, Pathfinder 1E, Cypher, and the Fate rulesets. Your gaming interface just got an upgrade!
[*] [b]Nostalgia Unleashed:[/b] Miss the older CoreRPG and D&D 5E themes? They're back as [i]Theme: FG Classic[/i] and [i]Theme: FG Leather[/i] extensions. Enjoy the best of both worlds!
[*] [b]Quality of Life Boost:[/b] The Assets window now remembers where you left off, making your GM duties smoother than ever.
[*][b]Pathfinder 2.0 Release 19[/b] provided even more automation and functionality. See the [url=https://www.fantasygrounds.com/forums/showthread.php?78915-Release-19-Information-and-feedback]details[/url]
[/list]

[h2]June Updates Revisited[/h2]
[list]
[*]animated image and token support with webp and webm integrated with our unique image brushes to paint some truly immersive maps
[*]uvtt file imports let you import from popular apps such as Dungeon Alchemist, Dungeon Painter Studio, and Dragon Map Maker
[*]integration with Syrinscape with new Sound Link Packs and support for local sounds
[*]Brand new dice packs
[/list]

[previewyoutube=XRhAjgKbAgk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]New Art Packs that Feature Animated Images[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2565300

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2518580

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2484870

Get ready to dive into a world of immersive tabletop adventures. Update Fantasy Grounds Unity today and experience role-playing like never before!

For more details on the update, check out our [url=https://www.fantasygrounds.com/filelibrary/patchnotes_ruleset.html]patch notes[/url]. Roll the dice, forge your destiny, and enjoy your gaming journey!

[h3]Coming September 7th, 2023[/h3]
We will be building a new ruleset for Werewolf: the Apocalypse. This ruleset will integrate with Vampire the Masquerade and other World of Darkness properties for a fun new experience. Sign up to be notified when the Kickstarter campaign launches on September 7th.

notes.title: Version 4.2.1 Release Notes
notes.notes:
Version 4.2.0 Feature Video
[previewyoutube=gNY16e3O9r4;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Version 4.2.1 (2022-05-25)[/b]
[list]
[*]Magnetic snap changed to default for image LoS tools.
[*]Image LoS line tool supports angle snap when holding Shift modifier key.
[*]Image LoS would get out of synch when map reshared with players when already open on player client. Fixed.
[*]Magnetic snap for image LoS tools would not always work. Fixed.
[*]Grid snap for image LoS tools was not working. Fixed. (Use Control key.)
[*]Image data panel FX sliders would not work right after selecting FX layer. Fixed.
[*]Image field view not always updating on token selection changes. Fixed.
[*]Image paint shapes using rotated stroke image assets would not display correctly on player client. Fixed.
[*]Using image paint select tool to delete points on shape with internal hole would create unexpected shapes. Fixed.
[*]Using image LoS select tool after splitting an existing path would sometimes cause old points to reappear or extra points to be selected. Fixed.
[*]Using image LoS select tool to drag selection of points and then pressing Enter key, intersection points would not be correctly created. Fixed.
[*]Console errors when opening some maps with specific characteristics generated in previous versions. Fixed.
[*]Console error when opening image fields in windows without image data panels (such as SW Adventure Deck). Fixed.
[*][DEV] Well-formed file URLs are supported as long as they point to a location within the FG data folder.
[/list]

[b]Version 4.2.0 (2022-05-17)[/b]

[list]
[*]Complete redesign of image painting functionality. (Open image data panel, select Paint mode.)
[*]Support for image/color fills, shadows and fades during paint operations.
[*]Support for boolean operations to create paint shapes using overlay modes.
[*]Eyedropper added to retrieve paint settings from existing paint shapes for additional shapes or to perform operations on existing shapes.
[*]Fill editing mode added to adjust existing paint shapes.
[*]Eyedropper paint tool not picking up correct color on Mac and Linux clients. Fixed.
[*]Lists would not draw child window correctly when child window edited to sort to first position in list. Fixed.
[*]Typing indicator not visible on player client for players joining after current client. Fixed.
[*]Using context menu to delete all tokens could sometimes cause endless exceptions until session restarted. Fixed.
[*]Scrolling text fields using control lines drew lines at incorrect positions when scrolled. Fixed.
[*]Large numbers of table rolls using non-3D dice types could cause stack overflow errors. Fixed.
[*]Players could undo GM token movement. Fixed.
[*][DEV] chatentry.onDeliverMessage updated to receive all non-system messages delivered by local client.
[*][DEV] chatwindow.onReceiveMessage updated to receive all non-system messages delivered by local or remote clients. (including messages with secret flag)
[*][DEV] chatwindow - Remove old prompt/halt menu/icons. Add via ruleset/extension code if desired.
[*][DEV] Comm - onDiceLanded - Dice total is output with dice data table.
[*][DEV] customdie - side tag definitions will have priority over custom onValue functions.
[*][DEV] customdie - onValue functions will receive die "side" as parameter (change for dF and d01 built-in die models to 1-6 and 1-10 ranges, respectively).
[*][DEV] imagecontrol - Mouse events and APIs adjusted to always return or use raw image units.
[*][DEV] Interface - openURL(url, callbackfn) -> callbackfn(url, response) API added.
[*][DEV] Module - export API adds exportassets/assetrewrites subtables to parameters.
[*][DEV] Module - export API no longer generates data file if no database nodes exported.
[*][DEV] Token - APIs adjusted to always return or use raw image units.
[*][DEV] tokeninstance - isVisible check would fail if token was selected. Fixed.
[*][DEV] tokeninstance - isVisible check would sometimes be incorrect on host when no tokens selected. Fixed.
[*][DEV] Utility - Added getDiceTotal(table) function.
[*][DEV] windowlist - Added getEmptyText() and setEmptyText(string) functions.
[*][DEV] windowlist - filter and filteron tags can now specify different types (field/control).
[*][DEV] windowlist - createWindow calls during events triggered by closeAll call could cause orphaned UI elements. Fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 4.1.12 Released
notes.notes:
The big change is that all actions on the Sidebar are not available by default in collapsing menu lists, with icons. This change impacted the vast majority of all official rulesets and may require updates to any community rulesets you may be using. It should greatly improve the ease of use and learning for the program as it no longer requires choosing which buttons are present on your sidebar in your Options.

The other big item is that you can now build your own Reference Manuals directly inside FGU. This allows you to recreate a PDF-style appearance for adventures, settings, etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38462416/d7f1245139cd58dec61b5ea318b31fc2a15e56ce.jpg[/img]

[h1]Ruleset Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] [CoreRPG+] Sidebar behavior updated to support collapsible categories and icons.
[CoreRPG+] Reference manual builder added for content developers.
[*] [CoreRPG+] Add message of the day link for placement on hot keys.
[*] [CoreRPG+] Sidebar record lists will preserve scroll position when rebuilding lists.
[*] [CoreRPG+] Paging support added to default module record lists and specialized list views (armor, weapons, etc).
[*] [CoreRPG+] Added decal selection dialog available via Options window.
[*] [CoreRPG+] Options buttons can be dragged to hot key bar.
[*] [CoreRPG+] Modifier key toggles can now be dragged to hot key bar.
[*] [CoreRPG+] Updated portrait selection dialog available via character sheets.
[*] [CoreRPG+] Campaign list filter combo box options will now update when associated fields are edited.
[*] [CoreRPG+] Name and health bar widgets will scale to larger token sizes.
[*] [CoreRPG+] Random encounter record links can now be dropped on encounter records.
[*] [CoreRPG+] Effects not being duplicated when dropping on campaign Effects list. Fixed.
[*] [CoreRPG+] Parcel and party sheet item assignments getting reset to quantity of 1, if PC sheet inventory has been opened on GM. Fixed.
[*] [CoreRPG+] When adding items from parcel or party sheet to character sheet and count was 0 on character sheet, an extra item would be added. Fixed.
[*] [CoreRPG+] Ordinal suffix on calendar dates for days 11-13 is incorrect. Fixed.
[*] [5E] Campaign setup dialog would not load Sword Coast Adventurer's Guide modules when selecting All Rules. Fixed.
[*] [5E] Character wizard generated script errors on unexpected partial word combinations. Fixed.
[*] [5E] NPC sheet action damage phrases not picking up melee/ranged trait. Fixed.
[*] [PFRPG/3.5E] NPC size attribute not being parsed for effect conditionals in certain modules. Fixed.
[*] [SFRPG] Missing labels on NPC starship records. Fixed.
[*] [SFRPG] PC vehicle wounds not displaying on combat tracker. Fixed.
[*] [SFRPG] Ranged damage not being decreased when affected by Fatigue condition. Fixed.
[*] [SFRPG] Vulnerability not working for kinetic damage types. Fixed.
[*] [SFRPG] Strength ability score not returning to normal after unequipping Power Armor. Fixed.
[*] [PFRPG/3.5E/SFRPG/d20Mod] Spell DC calculation incorrect for module NPCs not in combat tracker. Fixed.
[*] [DEV][CoreRPG+] Removal of FGC-specific code.
[*] [DEV][CoreRPG+] Module export window remembers all settings between sessions, including token and record type exports selected.
[*] [DEV][CoreRPG+] Specialized record view lists supported by ruleset are available in export window.
[*] [DEV][CoreRPG+] Added pre/post export callbacks (called once per record type, then once overall).
[*] [DEV][CoreRPG+] When exported, image assets (such as header/footer graphics) used in reference manuals that are not image record links will be stored in separate referenceimages folder, and not be included as Assets when module is installed.
[*] [DEV][CoreRPG+] Added fallback to default list if list view specified in module does not exist.
[*] [DEV][CoreRPG+] Added presets support to Modifiers window and ModifierManager script to register and specify exclusion sets.
[*] [DEV][CoreRPG+] Added bottom anchor templates to several utility windows to more easily adjust controls by just moving anchor.
[*] [DEV][CoreRPG+] Add ChatManager handler registration for onDiceLanded, onDrop, onDeliverMessage, onReceiveMessage, and onSlashCommand events.
[/list]

[h1]Client Engine Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Formatted text fields would remove empty table cells at end of text on load. Fixed.
[*] Players no longer able to vote after dice rolled. Fixed.
[*] Exceptions occur when tokens with maximum vision range effects intersect with darkness lights. Fixed.
[*] Lights added during play by GM not always showing up on player client display. Fixed.
[*] [Launcher] Text field caret would sometimes not be visible when editing fields while UI scale less than 100%. Fixed.
[*] [CoreRPG+] Using Images list Create From Campaign Assets button was incorrectly creating image records for all assets. Fixed.
[*] [DEV] Changed chatentrycontrol.onSlashCommand from handler to event.
[*] [DEV] Remove extraneous slash before command parameter of onSlashCommand event.
[*] [DEV] Add assetviewcontrol.nodrag tag.
[/list]

For a comprehensive list of all Client and Ruleset changes for all previous editions, please visit here:
https://www.fantasygrounds.com/filelibrary/patchnotes_v4.html
https://www.fantasygrounds.com/filelibrary/patchnotes_ruleset.html

notes.title: Image & Map Creation in Fantasy grounds Unity
notes.notes:
[h1]Image & Map Creation in Fantasy grounds Unity[/h1]

Fantasy Grounds Unity has a robust built-in map and image creation workspace with an extensive line of sight and dynamic lighting system that works in tandem for an unprecedented immersive experience. 
In this broadcast, we will be demonstrating the tools and workflow for the creation of maps inside Fantasy grounds Unity.

notes.title: Fantasy Grounds Tabletoptop Fest With David Middleton
notes.notes:
David Middleton from Fantasy Grounds will be giving a tour of the Fantasy Grounds website, webstore, forums, new Forge, and a brief tour of the Fantasy Grounds Unity software.

There will be a brief Q&A towards the end of the stream as well so bring your questions.

This event will be streamed live across the web on Twitch, YouTube, Facebook, Steam, and DLive.

notes.title: LET THERE BE LIGHT! Version 4.1 of Fantasy Grounds Unity
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38462416/448873bad478951991c252cffbb638d3826b633f.jpg[/img]

[h1]LET THERE BE LIGHT![/h1]

Version 4.1 of Fantasy Grounds Unity is NOW AVAILABLE (2021-05-13)

This version includes dynamic light and vision support for the core application and presets set within many different rulesets. It also includes a redesigned Image Toolbar for previous functions. 

Add Point Lights (with custom color, dim & bright ranges, flicker/pulse effects)

Add Ambient Lights (Dawn, Dusk, Sunlight, Moonlight presets) and mask to only cover some areas, adjust shadow length, direction, color, etc.

Add token lights or use new effects for Candle, Lantern, Torch, etc.)

Add token vision - Darkvision, Blindsight, Truesight, Devilsight with automatic application from character sheet in 5E

Version 4.1.0 (2021-05)

NOTE: Darkness lights are included as an experimental feature in this release; and may not always work as expected until a future release.

[h2]Adding Lights to Maps[/h2]
[previewyoutube=TaFvDapOlL4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Advanced Lighting and Vision[/h2]
[previewyoutube=u5Su3L4YTYo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Player and NPC Vision Support[/h2]
[previewyoutube=_lOs9eqOpu0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Release Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Image point light support added. (Lighting mode in image control panel)
[*] Image ambient light support and masks added. (Lighting mode in image control panel)
[*] Token vision and light support added. (Built-in to rulesets; or via lighting mode in image control panel)
[*] GM image token movement behavior changed block token movement based on line-of-sight to mirror player behavior. Use the Shift key to override movement limits, and disable vision/lighting updates.
[*] Changed occluder creation to use Alt key to create closed shapes (was Shift).
[*] Shift key used during occluder creation to limit lines to 45 degree angles. (30 on hex grids)
[*] Updated mask mode to show mask as blue outlines when masking/unmasking.
[*] Changed extensions and rulesets to always highlight and show tooltip on launch screen when mousing over list.
[*] Image layer visibility cycling order changed to: Visible -> Invisible -> GM Only
[*] Disabled undo for all image actions. (future release will revisit undo/redo for image actions)
[*] Launcher Join Campaign history delete button did not refresh history list. Fixed.
[*] Image line-of-sight data on layers within folders not working. Fixed.
[*] Module images would re-sort incorrectly when edited and reloaded. Fixed.
[*] /mood command not working on GM client. Fixed.
[*] Map grid memory leak when closing image windows or zooming in/out. Fixed.
[*] Image line-of-sight blocker pit type blocked visibility when token was in pit area. Fixed.
[*] Pits in separate layers sometimes do not block movement. Fixed.
[*] Grid lines not blending to image correctly. Fixed.
[*] Duplicate token created when dragging a map token, and clicking multiple mouse buttons. Fixed.
[*] Grid snap toggle would sometimes not work the first time it was clicked. Fixed.
[*] Player image view would black out when token selected by player was deleted by GM (or extension). Fixed.
[*] Image tiles not able to be rotated counter-clockwise. Fixed.
[*] Image token line-of-sight not updated correctly over network when door opened. Fixed.
[*] Typing idle state timer not working correctly. Fixed.
[*] Dragdata object warnings when returning to launch screen. Fixed.
[*] [CoreRPG+] Added mask button to image toolbar when mask turned on.
[*] [CoreRPG+] Background image panel scroller missing. Fixed.
[*] [CoreRPG+] Combat tracker name link icon not updating when combat tracker width changed. Fixed.
[*] [CoreRPG+] Die results incorrect for d2 and d3 when number of dice exceed physical roll limit (60). Fixed.
[*] [CoreRPG+] Player client health bars for owned tokens not updating correctly. Fixed.
[*] [SW] Trait fields not highlighting when dragging benny. Fixed.
[*] [DEV] Changed database update events to fire in new order: control events, current node events, child node events, network events.
[*] [DEV] Control widgets not updating position when control size and position changed. Fixed.
[*] [DEV] Drop highlight frames not displaying when control nested in subwindow/windowlist controls. Fixed.
[*] [DEV] Custom die scripts getting incorrect incoming value when using die model different than die name. Fixed.
[*] [DEV] Button hover states not displaying correctly on hover state changes. Fixed.
[*] [DEV] imagecontrol.snapToGrid API was returning incorrect Y value. Fixed.
[*] [DEV] Adjusted load order to prevent windows from being added to child window list of windowlist objects until control initialization of child window complete. (to match FGC behavior)
[*] [DEV] Token onMove script events added when token moved by remote client. (to match FGC behavior)
[/list]

notes.title: Release Updates for April 20th, 2021
notes.notes:
Release Updates for April 20th, 2021
Please remember not to update right before a game starts.

In order for some of the updates to be visible, you may need to open the modules window from Library->Modules, right click on the module and select "revert changes". Be warned, any edits you've made will be lost.

Note: Hotfixes are to fix an immediate problem that prevents using a product. They are not fully tested and may introduce other issues. If you have issues with a hotfix please contact support.

The following products have been updated:

Index Card RPG (Index Card Roleplaying Game)
[Added] Added new "COST" effect that modifies the HP cost of actions.
[Updated] Added a new 'infinite' icon to the room timer.
[Updated] SHIELD effect now allows you to specify effort and damage types that the shield will absorb
[Updated] SHIELD effect now allows you to specify "cost", so the shield will only absorb damage as a result of an action's cost.
[Updated] Added option to automatically roll ultimate on a critical success
[Updated] A new CRIT effect to modify the critical threshold of attempts
[Fixed] Game option to specify 'simple' or 'detailed' hp categories works correctly now
[Fixed] Negative effects now stack correctly


Tasha's Cauldron of Everything (D&D fifth edition)
[Fixed] Rhythm Drum rarity


D&D Volo's Guide to Monsters (D&D fifth edition)
[Fixed] Illithilich stat block
[Fixed] Typo in Goliath race


D&D Classics: Dungeon Masters Guide (2E) (D&D Classics - AD&D 1E/2E)
[Fixed] Cleric turn table error corrected.


D&D Classics: Player's Handbook (2E) (D&D Classics - AD&D 1E/2E)
[Fixed] Cleric turn table error corrected.
[Fixed] Removed test random encounter entry.


2E Ruleset (2E Compatible)
[Fixed] Initiative misplaced (drag/drop) in DM CT no longer hangs the system.
[Fixed] Armor damage only on damage.
[Added] Effect for IF or IFT option, RANGE(), that will check range on target for attack.


D&D Unearthed Arcana (D&D fifth edition)
[Added] Article Folk of the Feywild
[Added] Article Draconic Options


Starfinder RPG - Attack of the Swarm AP 3: Huskworld (Starfinder)
[Fixed] All caps in library with normal case.
[Fixed] Races added Speed and Senses if needed


Starfinder RPG - Attack of the Swarm AP 2: The Last Refuge (Starfinder)
[Fixed] All caps in library with normal case.
[Fixed] Starship Item to normal case

Starfinder RPG - Starfinder Armory (Starfinder)
[Fixed] Wonder Grenade, added the tables and links for item

Starfinder RPG - Alien Archive 3 (Starfinder)
[Fixed] Races that did not add Speed and Senses to character sheet correctly.
[Fixed] All caps in the library to normal case.
[Removed] Bad characters (FGU)


Starfinder Alien Archive 2 (Starfinder)
[Fixed] All caps in library changed to normal case
[Fixed] Races that did not add the Speed and Senses to a character correctly

Starfinder RPG - Alien Archive 4 (Starfinder)
[Fixed] Race Traits to add the correct information to the Character Sheet. (Speed and Senses)
[Fixed] Bad links from previous changes. (reference manual links for armor, class features, items, races, spells and weapons now link to the Players version)

notes.title: New Features - Oct 22nd Update
notes.notes:
The team has been busy adding in new features. None of these were on our original roadmap for FGU, so this is exciting. 

[b]In this video: [/b]

[list]
[*]Measuring on maps - using a hex grid and overland measurement that are different than the standard 5' per square 
[*]Asset window updates with better paging, no more scrolling, image previews and image import to campaign 
[*]Map Fx Layer Parameters and Layer Masks - now you can make it raining outside and stay nice and dry inside your little cave or castle.
[/list]

[b]Digital Tabletop Fest Going on Now[/b]
Take advantage of big discounts across much of our catalog. The sale is running through October 26.

If you know anyone else looking to try out Fantasy Grounds Unity, you can get that now for 10% off.

[b]Early Access/Beta Ending Soon[/b]
We will be leaving Early Access during the first week of November. At this point, the program is running great and we don't expect any more critical updates. We will, as always, continue to evolve the program over time and add even more features.

notes.title: New Pointers, Area of Effect and Targeting - plus new LOS object types
notes.notes:
[h1]Pointers, Area of Effect and Targeting[/h1]
Carl and Joshua teamed up to redesign the look and feel of the pointers within FGU. We adopted a similar style to token locking, but made it different enough that it will stand out when intermixed. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38462416/cd078cf8df3bcfc5a9d901c653d9833438d820a1.jpg[/img]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Fkxw8kxrxBA]Link to YouTube Video[/url]

[h1]New Line of Sight Object Types[/h1]
[h2]Windows, Illusionary Walls, Pits[/h2]
Carl also implemented some new LOS objects you can use for Illusionary Walls, Windows and Pits. Windows let you see through it but block movement if closed. Illusionary Walls block vision by not movement. Pits block movement and vision if you fall inside it. The GM can open and close pits. 

Check out the [url=https://fantasygroundsunity.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/FGU/pages/950633/Working+with+Images+as+the+GM#Layer-Line-of-Sight-(LOS)]updated wiki[/url] for more detail.

[h1]Leaving Early Access Soon[/h1]
We are looking at possible dates next month to leave Early Access. Over the last 3 months, there have been 834 thousand hours of gameplay by GMs running Fantasy Grounds Unity. It is not unusual for us to have more than 3,000 games running concurrently on a weekend. We are happy to report that the number of issues being reported is very low for a sample size this large. We will continue to improve upon the game over time, but this feels very solid to us at this stage.

notes.title: Token Locking Feature Added
notes.notes:
We just now rolled out the updated Token Locking mechanism. We think it is a big improvement over the version in FG Classic. We will be following this up with a similar graphical update for pointers and area of effect drawings.

You can see instructions for how to use it on our wiki here (which will be updated over time):
https://fantasygroundsunity.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/FGU/pages/758841345/Token+Locking+-+GM+Approved+Player+Movement

Token Locking is a feature that allows the GM to lock tokens in place and force all movement to be displayed as planned pathways. The GM can then approve or reject movement on a per token basis. Once enabled on a map, any attempted move by players will need to be confirmed by the GM. GMs can continue to move NPC or player tokens without token locking, or they can use the same feature by holding CTRL when they start their move.


[h1]Enable Token Locking for a Map[/h1]

[h2]Step 1: Unlock the Map[/h2]
Starting with a campaign map, unlock the map to expose the Image Data Control.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38462416/3628fef51ddb63acdaa72539076ba3db99faa654.png[/img]

If you don’t see the Unlock button, make sure it is in your campaign folder. Drag the image to your campaigns images & maps window.

[h2]Step 2: Turn on Token Locking[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38462416/0059ece5e89b91dd29b7a33d7c3fe012da90e6a7.png[/img]

[h3]Snap To Grid[/h3]
Optionally, turn on Snap to Grid. This will snap all movement to edges, corners or mid-points of grids for all planned movement unless you are holding down CTRL.


[h1]Step 3: GM Movement[/h1]
GM movement won’t appear to change if you use arrow keys for movement or drag tokens around. This is because GM’s are not restricted by token locking by default. To restrict movement for the GM just like it is for players, hold down CTRL when performing your move. 

[list]
[*]CTRL+arrow keys
[*]CTRL+drag (release after starting the drag if you also have snap to grid enabled)
[/list]

Here is planned movement for the goblin token. Release the mouse to make a waypoint and drag again from the waypoint to start a new movement segment.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38462416/072a8b9202bbb57917d8c081ee2599a18745ae62.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38462416/bbc9be4570a735ab268dcd59cb6e19381a1faa85.png[/img]

The GM can click on the Green checkmark to approve movement or the Red X to cancel the movement.

[h3]Moving Waypoints[/h3]
[list]
[*]Waypoints can be dragged to update the overall movement distance. 
[*]Waypoints can be dragged over top of another waypoint to collapse them into a single waypoint
[*]Arrow key movement will create a new waypoint every time you change direction
[/list]

[h1]Step 4: Player Movement[/h1]
Players can show planned movement for any token they own. The movement path shown will begin with their player color. GM’s can see this and approve or cancel the movement.

Players can move into any area they have previously revealed.

Players can propose movement into areas they have not previously revealed. GM’s can approve this movement or edit it. If approved, the player will move as far as they can until they hit a wall or other obstruction (if using a map with Line of Sight defined).

James Fingerlighter attempts to move into the room ahead and then back down. Since James has never explored this area, the path he is planning is only partially allowed. He would hit a wall at some point.

Player View of Planned Movement
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38462416/4e1d100c0b6055ef2a35d9262a519f0f31de9b32.png[/img]

The GM can see this and can approve the movement anyway. James will move as far as he can until he hits a wall and then he will stop.

GM View of James' Planned Movement
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38462416/04986b994e66a3ae2f37ea2d3df5157a4a9d894e.png[/img]

[h1]Calculating Diagonal Movement Distance[/h1]
You may notice that total movement distance is calculated differently from ruleset to ruleset. The 5E ruleset has a Standard movement setting that counts every diagonal square as 5' of movement. This can be adjusted in the Campaign Options to use either Variant to show 5' followed by 10' for the 2nd diagonal movement (i.e. 5, 15, 20, 30) or Raw movement which shows decimal points and a true distance traveled.
